svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Conductor versus insulator as 3D lattices: a sea of free electrons versus electrons locked in bonds
svg.text: fixed atom cores in a sea of free electrons
apply a voltage: the whole sea drifts
every outer electron locked in a bond
apply a voltage: nothing free to move
(an electron pair sits on every bond)
